description: Returns the user's saved deals, newest first, one line each: address, price, latest price drop, score (0–100), monthly cash flow, cash-on-cash and cap rate (fractions), or for live-in the monthly cost and budget gap, plus status and, when numbers can't be computed, why, and the profile they were computed with. "total" counts all matches before the limit.

limit.description: At most this many lines (default 50, max 200).

minScore.description: Only deals scoring at least this.

anyOf.description: Strategy the numbers are computed in: buy-and-hold, house-hack, brrrr or live-in (living in it).

scoreAs.description: "saved" (default) computes each deal in the strategy it was saved in; a strategy name computes every deal in that one.

strategy.description: Only deals saved in this strategy.

name: list_deals
